name: GROVER
aka: Goddard Remotely Operated Vehicle for Exploration and Research
def: Solar powered autonomous rover, designed by students and developed at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center to collect low cost data on the Greenland ice sheet.
facts: Tested on the Greenland ice sheet at Summit Camp from 3 May to 8 June 2013
Operated in temperatures down to minus 30 °C
Science team led by Goddard glaciologist Lora Koenig
